Akanksha Arora | industry = Gems & Jewellery | products = Jewelry & Accessories | num_employees = | website = {{Official website|http://www.amrapalijewels.com}} | footnotes = }} '''Amrapali Jewels''' is a [[jewellery]] house founded in 1978 by Rajiv Arora and Rajesh Ajmera in [[Jaipur]].{{cite web|url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-dna-mumbai-anniversary-indulgence-is-now-on-a-roll-2642551|title=DNA Mumbai Anniversary: Indulgence is now on a roll|date=28 July 2018}} Amrapali designs, produces and distributes tribal, fine and uncut gemstone jewellery. The brand has stores in India and London.{{cite web|url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/1003943/amrapali-opens-first-store-in-pakistan/|title=Amrapali opens first store in Pakistan – The Express Tribune|date=4 December 2015}}{{cite web|url=http://www.theweek.co.uk/91983/tarang-arora-the-story-of-amrapali|title=Tarang Arora: The story of Amrapali|website=The Week Portfolio|date=28 February 2018 }}{{cite web|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/amrapali-launches-baahubali-jewelry-at-hyderabad-store/646498/|title=Amrapali launches 'Baahubali' jewelry at Hyderabad store|date=28 April 2017}}{{cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/videos/luxury-market/2014/amrapali-jewels-tarang-arora-indian-luxury-market/210207.html|title=Tarang Arora on history and journey of Amrapali Jewels : Luxury Market: Business Today|website=businesstoday.in|date=10 September 2014 }} The brand also operates a museum of [[Indian jewellery]] in Jaipur.{{cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2017/03/24/fashion/jewelry-amrapali-museum.html|title=In Homage to India's Jewel Culture|work=The New York Times |date=24 March 2017 |last1=Liu |first1=Ming }}{{cite web|url=https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/amrapali-museum-to-open-next-january-in-jaipur/article21390236.ece|title=Amrapali Museum to open next January in Jaipur|first=Rosella|last=Stephen|date=11 December 2017|work=[[The Hindu]]}} ==Historical background== Amrapali Jewels was founded by Rajiv Arora and Rajesh Ajmera, who studied subjects related to ancient Indian culture during their graduate education.{{cite web|url=http://www.thesmartceo.in/magazine/growth-enterprise/a-cut-above-the-rest.html|title=A cut above the rest – SmartCEO|date=1 October 2012|access-date=21 May 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140521205452/http://www.thesmartceo.in/magazine/growth-enterprise/a-cut-above-the-rest.html|archive-date=21 May 2014|url-status=dead}} In January 2025, House of Masaba and Amrapali Jewels jointly launched a fine jewellery collection. Tribe Amrapali, a subsidiary of Amrapali Jewels, had previously collaborated with designer [[Masaba Gupta]] on the ''Ghana Ghana'' collection.{{Cite web |last=Mishra |first=Manish |date=2025-01-26 |title=Masaba x Amrapali Jewels: The art of making fine jewellery |url=https://www.livemint.com/mint-lounge/style/masaba-amrapali-jewels-fine-jewellery-11737869360208.html |access-date=2025-08-04 |website=mint |language=en}} == Indian jewellery museum == The brand operates an [[Amrapali Museum]] of Jewellery, spread over a {{convert|6500|sqft|m2}} space and showcasing traditional Indian Jewellery in the city of Jaipur. The collection took 50 years to be gathered.{{cite web|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/art-and-culture/now-showing-at-a-museum-near-you-bhagat-singh-s-gun-sachin-s-gloves/story-DRamlNcWMsUCMelr9exPHI.html|title=Now showing at a museum near you: Bhagat Singh's gun, Sachin's gloves|date=5 May 2017|work=[[Hindustan Times]]}}{{cite web|url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/specials/power-of-i_2016/star-jeweller-amrapali-jewels-2780|title=Star Jeweller – Amrapali Jewels|work=[[Outlook (Indian magazine)|Outlook]]|date=2 June 2016 }}{{cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/Leisure/DHLEDnnCfqZq7KCna4gBMM/Fancy-a-rubystudded-back-scratcher.html|title=Fancy a ruby-studded back scratcher?|first=Vatsala|last=Chhibber|date=23 February 2018|publisher= [[Livemint]]}}{{cite web|url=https://www.dnaindia.com/just-before-monday/report-jewels-from-a-museum-2597314|title=Jewels from a museum|date=25 March 2018}}{{cite web|url=https://www.deccanchronicle.com/sunday-chronicle/cover-story/010418/treasures-from-the-past.html|title=Treasures from the past|date=1 April 2018|work=[[Deccan Chronicle]]}} == Income Tax Department raid == On 13 July 2020, the [[Income Tax Department|I.T. Department]] raided Amrapali Jewels and its owner Rajiv Arora, who is a close aide of [[Indian National Congress|Congress]] [[List of chief ministers of Rajasthan|CM]], [[Ashok Gehlot]] and Vice President of the [[Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee]]{{cite web |title=My Journey |url=http://www.rajivarora.com/english/my-journey.html |publisher=Rajiv Arora |via=rajivarora.com}} for tax evasion at various locations, including [[Mumbai]] and [[Delhi]].{{cite web |title=I-T raids at premises owned by Gehlot's aides |url=https://www.firstpost.com/politics/rajasthan-government-political-crisis-live-updates-sachin-pilot-ashok-gehlot-congress-bjp-sonia-gandhi-scindia-assembly-elections-mla-cm-latest-news-8589511.html/amp |website=FirstPost.com|date=13 July 2020 }} There was also a case in 2015 registered against Amrapali Jewels regarding bogus purchases of precious and semi-precious stones.{{cite web |title=Amrapali Jewels Pvt. Ltd., Jaipur vs Department Of Income Tax on 24 November, 2015 |url=https://indiankanoon.org/doc/35833806/ |publisher=[[Indian Kanoon]] |via=indiankanoon.org}} ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Companies based in Rajasthan]] [[Category:Indian jewellers]] [[Category:Jewellery retailers of India]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1978]] [[Category:1978 establishments in Rajasthan]]
extract: Amrapali Jewels is a jewellery house founded in 1978 by Rajiv Arora and Rajesh Ajmera in Jaipur. Amrapali designs, produces and distributes tribal, fine and uncut gemstone jewellery. The brand has stores in India and London. The brand also operates a museum of Indian jewellery in Jaipur.
